question: What claim about the classes of yoginīs is at stake in listing all innate, all family-born, and all door-guardians together?
premises: All door-guardians are named as a class.
inference: These three classes together constitute a complete set of yoginīs in this context.
uncertainties: The relation between the three classes is not specified within this verse alone.
plain_english: All innate, all family-born, and all door-guardians.
